title_en: A big wedding in the village

lines.en: A big wedding in the village,
a big wedding in the village.
Peter vojvoda was getting married,
Peter vojvoda was getting married.
He invited his nine sisters,
he invited his nine sisters.
He didn't invite his tenth sister,
he didn't invite his tenth sister.

lines.cyr: Сам Петре дојде по неа, леле,
lines.lat: Sam Petre dojde po nea, lele,
lines.en: He went to invite her personally,
he went to invite her personally.

lines.cyr: - Ај, дојди сестро на свадба, леле,
lines.lat: - Aj, dojdi sestro na svadba, lele,
lines.en: Come, sister, come to my wedding,
come, sister, come to my wedding.

lines.cyr: - Не можам брату да дојдам, леле,
lines.lat: - Ne možam bratu da dojdam, lele,
lines.en: I can not come, my brother,
I can not come, my brother.

lines.cyr: Тешка ми куќа на глава, леле,
lines.lat: Teška mi kuḱa na glava, lele,
lines.en: I have a household to worry about,
I have a household to worry about.

lines.cyr: Машко ми дете на раце, леле,
lines.lat: Maško mi dete na race, lele,
lines.en: I have a baby boy in my hands,
I have a baby boy in my hands.

lines.cyr: А друго лежи на срце, леле,
lines.lat: A drugo leži na srce, lele,
lines.en: And another one is in my heart,
and another one is in my heart.
